generation.baseline_by_pause: Report test provenance only, four repeated prefix families per branch/pause
generation.gate: Iterate cropping first/last RMS-active bounds after a fresh 1 ms linear edge taper until both terminal frames stay active
generation.limitation: Artificial hard-gated speech excises faint speech and can introduce splice/taper artifacts; not full-utterance phonetic truth
generation.selection_policy: Reuse 156 frozen primary policies and shared 0/200 ms baselines; no diagnostic fitting or ranking selection
generation.source_rms_proxy: Emitted per-source PCM normalized to -20 dBFS; 10 ms RMS >= max(-48 dBFS, peak frame RMS -40 dB)
generation.split_policy: Primary dev/test labels preserved as provenance; texts and voices reused, not a fresh independent holdout
